sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A polynomial has degree 5 and leading coefficient 5. Describe its end behaviour.
choices: the left end falls and the right end rises
the left end rises and the right end falls

items.prompt: For f(x) = (x − 4) / (x + 4), state the vertical asymptote and the horizontal asymptote.
Function f is given in vertex form as f(x) = −(x − 4)² − 2, so it opens downward. Function g is given by a table whose greatest output is -1. Which function has the greater maximum, and by how much?
The function f(x) = 4(x − 3)² − 7 opens upward. State its minimum value and where it occurs.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.prompt: A polynomial has degree 5 and leading coefficient -3. Describe its end behaviour.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
